role: Data and Analytics Engineering Lead, Reinsurance
job_location: New York, New York; Norwalk, Connecticut; Princeton, New Jersey, United States of America
responsibilities: Lead the design and implementation of enterprise BI architecture, including data models, dashboards, reports, and data gateways, ensuring optimal performance, usability, and security.

Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable BI solutions, including data modeling, DAX calculations, and visualization best practices. Ensure adherence to data governance and compliance standards in data modeling and architecture
Provide subject matter expertise in the Reinsurance domain for data analytics.
Architect and oversee the integration of Power BI with various data sources, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Databricks, and other cloud or on-premise data platforms.
Define analytic solution leveraging Databricks, DBT and Power BI.
Develop and enforce development standards, governance policies, and best practices to ensure consistency, security, and maintainability across all reports and dashboards.
Support the deployment of Power BI in enterprise environments, including managing data refresh schedules, security roles, and workspace governance.
Identify and address performance bottlenecks in data pipelines and queries. Implement strategies to optimize data processing and reduce latency in data delivery
Optimize Power BI performance by implementing best practices in data modeling, query optimization, and report design.
Produce comprehensive design documentation, deployment plans, and user guides.
Stay current with Power BI innovations and industry best practices, recommending improvements to enhance reporting capabilities.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Develop and enforce development standards, governance policies, and best practices to ensure consistency, security, and maintainability across all reports and dashboards.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: governance, compliance, security and maintainability recur through the responsibilities, and no speed or shipping language appears anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: Ensure adherence to data governance and compliance standards in data modeling and architecture
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: High: this is reinsurance at Marsh McLennan and compliance with data governance standards is written into the responsibilities themselves.
evidence.data_team_maturity: As Data and Analytics Engineering Lead within our Reinsurance Data and Analytics team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mature: there is an established Reinsurance Data and Analytics team with separate data engineers and analysts, enterprise Power BI already deployed, and governance policies in force.
evidence.jd_authorship: Support the deployment of Power BI in enterprise environments, including managing data refresh schedules, security roles, and workspace governance.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Hiring_manager: the bullets name the specific stack and operational detail — data gateways, refresh schedules, security roles, workspace governance, Databricks and DBT — so the actual work is legible.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable BI solutions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Internal_data: the named partners are data engineers and analysts, and the deliverable is the enterprise BI and modelling layer they build on.
evidence.autonomy_level: Lead the design and implementation of enterprise BI architecture
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic: the role leads, architects, defines and enforces — 'Develop and enforce development standards, governance policies, and best practices' — rather than delivering scoped work.
evidence.ai_role: Leveraging AI to enabling Ad Hoc and Self Serve BI capabilities
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Ai_enabler: the candidate is expected to build BI capability that AI drives for end users, so the AI sits downstream of their modelling work.
evidence.testing_framing: Develop and enforce development standards, governance policies, and best practices to ensure consistency, security, and maintainability across all reports and dashboards.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: the candidate owns and enforces the governance and standards practice, though the JD never names a testing tool or framework.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure adherence to data governance and compliance standards in data modeling and architecture
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High: compliance and governance appear in the opening summary and again in the second responsibility, so the fear is governance failure in a regulated reinsurance setting.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Lead the design and implementation of enterprise BI architecture, including data models, dashboards, reports, and data gateways
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed: the architecture is being designed and implemented, while two bullets are about optimising existing pipelines and Power BI performance.
